label: Presidential Approval Rating
source: Bloomberg LatAm Pulse / multiple pollsters, end-April 2026
deltaNote: Peaked at 85% Feb 2025; fell to 72% Mar 2026; 54% Mar 2026; now 51% — lowest of presidency. Driven by Q1 GDP contraction (-0.8%), CIA-Chihuahua sovereignty crisis, DOJ indictment of Sinaloa governor, and economic anxiety.

label: Homicide Rate (per 100k)

delta: -41% daily avg in Q1 2026 vs Dec 2024

label: Total Homicides (2025)
contestNote: Lowest since 2016 but disappearances up 16% vs AMLO final year; six states saw homicide increases

label: GDP Growth (2025 actual / Q1 2026 preliminary)
source: INEGI preliminary Q1 2026, Apr 30; Banxico Feb 2026 report
contestNote: Q1 2026 preliminary: -0.8% quarterly contraction, +0.2% annual. All three sectors declined. Government projects 1.8–2.8% for full-year 2026; IMF/BBVA forecast 1.6–1.8%. Sharp rebound required in Q2–Q4.
deltaNote: All sectors contracted: primary -1.4%, secondary -1.1%, tertiary -0.6%. $17.4B in investment lost to U.S. tariff uncertainty per Expansión.

label: Annual Inflation
delta: -0.14pp vs March 2026 (4.59%); first deceleration of 2026. Upward: serrano peppers +36.27%, tomatoes +19.27%. Downward: green tomatoes -34.8%, electricity -14% (summer subsidy). Monthly CPI +0.20%; core +0.31% monthly / +4.26% annual

label: FDI (Jan–Sep 2025)
contestNote: Headline FDI record; critics note new greenfield investment dropped 34% to $3.17B in 2024; most is reinvestment by existing companies

label: Banxico Policy Rate
source: Banco de México official press release, May 7, 2026; Bloomberg
delta: -475bp from 11.25% peak; 15th consecutive cut; 3-2 split vote May 7, 2026. Board guidance: easing cycle is over — 'appropriate to maintain at current level.' No further cuts expected through 2027.
